meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先思考界面的用途和视觉方向,再输出风格独特、可直接运行的前端代码。它会通过排版、配色、动效等细节让界面有辨识度,避免常见的模板化 AI 设计。
howto.when: 当你要求构建网页组件、页面或应用程序时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个极简风格的落地页
say.note: 它会先定极简方向,再写对应代码。

say.text: 设计一个复古未来感的仪表盘
say.note: 它会选复古配色与字体,生成界面。

say.text: 把这个博客页改成杂志排版风格
say.note: 它会重排布局,加入编辑感字体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first think about the interface's purpose and visual direction, then output distinctive, runnable frontend code. It uses typography, color, motion, and other details to give the interface a recognizable look while avoiding common template-like AI design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications.

say_en.note: It will set a minimalist direction and generate matching code.
It will pick retro-futuristic colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Restyle this blog into a magazine layout.
say_en.note: It will rearrange layout with editorial typography.
